metadata.question: Are there active fires in October 24, 2023 in Canada?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS daily fire mask products for Oct 24, 2023 over Canada. Primary: MODIS Terra (MOD14A1) and Aqua (MYD14A1). If both missing, fallback to VIIRS daily fire mask (VNP14A1). If still missing, fallback to MODIS 8-day fire mask (MCD14A2) covering the date.
2. Masking strategy: Use FireMask classes 7–9 (low/nominal/high-confidence fires). No cloud masking needed; FireMask encodes detection.
3. Logic: If collections are empty after fallbacks => C1. If images exist but reduceRegion returns no valid pixels => C2. If reduce results are null/invalid => C3. Otherwise, if any fire pixels > 0 => A, else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const dateStart = '2023-10-24';
    const dateEnd = '2023-10-25'; // end-exclusive
    const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Canada'));
    const canada = countries.geometry();

    // Helper to compute fire pixel count and valid pixel count from FireMask image
    async function computeFireStats(img, label) {
      if (!img) {
        return {label, fireCount: null, validCount: null, pct: null};
      }
      const fire = img.gte(7).and(img.lte(9)).rename('fire'); // classes 7-9 = fires
      const fireCount = await fire.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: canada,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).get('fire').getInfo();

      const validCount = await img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: canada,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13
      }).get('FireMask').getInfo();

      let pct = null;
      if (fireCount !== null && validCount && validCount > 0) {
        pct = (fireCount / validCount) * 100.0;
      }
      return {label, fireCount, validCount, pct};
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const terraCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1')
      .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
      .select(['FireMask']);
    const aquaCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1')
      .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
      .select(['FireMask']);

    const terraSize = await terraCol.size().getInfo();
    const aquaSize = await aquaCol.size().getInfo();
    console.log(`Terra MOD14A1 images: ${terraSize}`);
    console.log(`Aqua  MYD14A1 images: ${aquaSize}`);

    let usedDataset = 'MODIS Terra+Aqua daily';
    let terraImg = null;
    let aquaImg = null;

    if (terraSize > 0) terraImg = terraCol.mosaic();
    if (aquaSize > 0) aquaImg = aquaCol.mosaic();

    // Fallback 1: VIIRS daily FireMask if both Terra and Aqua are missing
    let viirsCol = null, viirsSize = 0, viirsImg = null;
    if ((terraSize === 0) && (aquaSize === 0)) {
      viirsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1')
        .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
        .select(['FireMask']);
      viirsSize = await viirsCol.size().getInfo();
      console.log(`VIIRS VNP14A1 images: ${viirsSize}`);
      if (viirsSize > 0) {
        viirsImg = viirsCol.mosaic();
        usedDataset = 'VIIRS VNP14A1 daily';
      }
    }

    // Fallback 2: MODIS 8-day FireMask if still nothing
    let mcdCol = null, mcdSize = 0, mcdImg = null;
    if ((terraSize === 0) && (aquaSize === 0) && (!viirsImg)) {
      const eightDayStart = '2023-10-20';
      const eightDayEnd = '2023-10-28';
      mcdCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14A2')
        .filterDate(eightDayStart, eightDayEnd)
        .select(['FireMask']);
      mcdSize = await mcdCol.size().getInfo();
      console.log(`MODIS MCD14A2 (8-day) images: ${mcdSize}`);
      if (mcdSize > 0) {
        mcdImg = mcdCol.mosaic();
        usedDataset = 'MODIS MCD14A2 8-day';
      }
    }

    // If no images in any dataset
    if ((terraSize === 0) && (aquaSize === 0) && (!viirsImg) && (!mcdImg)) {
      console.log('No images found for the date/location in all datasets checked.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing & Counts
    let stats = [];
    if (terraImg) {
      const s = await computeFireStats(terraImg.select('FireMask'), 'Terra');
      stats.push(s);
    }
    if (aquaImg) {
      const s = await computeFireStats(aquaImg.select('FireMask'), 'Aqua');
      stats.push(s);
    }
    if ((!terraImg && !aquaImg) && viirsImg) {
      const s = await computeFireStats(viirsImg.select('FireMask'), 'VIIRS');
      stats.push(s);
    }
    if ((!terraImg && !aquaImg && !viirsImg) && mcdImg) {
      const s = await computeFireStats(mcdImg.select('FireMask'), 'MCD14A2');
      stats.push(s);
    }

    // Check for calculation failures or no valid pixels
    let anyCalcFailure = false;
    let anyValidPixels = false;
    let anyFires = false;

    for (const s of stats) {
      if (s.validCount !== null && s.validCount > 0) anyValidPixels = true;
      if (s.fireCount === null && (s.validCount === null || s.validCount > 0)) anyCalcFailure = true;
      if (s.fireCount !== null && s.fireCount > 0) anyFires = true;
    }

    // 4. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`Dataset used: ${usedDataset}`);
    stats.forEach(s => {
      const fc = (s.fireCount === null) ? 'null' : s.fireCount;
      const vc = (s.validCount === null) ? 'null' : s.validCount;
      const pct = (s.pct === null) ? 'null' : `${s.pct.toFixed(4)}%`;
      console.log(`${s.label} Fire px: ${fc} / Valid px: ${vc} (${pct})`);
    });

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (!anyValidPixels) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (anyCalcFailure) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (anyFires) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
